title: Air Force flies Benowitz to Archuleta Mesa with props staged
place_text: Archuleta Mesa, Jicarilla Apache reservation, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Paul was very excited when he told him that the Air Force had taken him in a helicopter from Kirtland,

plain: In the early 1980s, the Air Force is said to have flown Paul Bennewitz, a New Mexico man caught up in UFO claims, by helicopter from Kirtland, an Air Force base in Albuquerque, to Archuleta Mesa on the Jicarilla Apache reservation, where props had been set up for him to see. Greg Bishop, a researcher who studied the Bennewitz case, passes on what he was told by the men around it, the Air Force intelligence agent Rick Doty and the UFO writer Bill Moore, and he says Bennewitz was very excited when he described the trip. If true, it would mean the military deliberately fed a believer a staged scene to steer what he believed.
